searchText: As of now, is there any limit to the withdrawal address provided? (i.e., could it be either an externally owned account or a contract address?) no limit the current specification is here: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4895#state-transition the balance of the owner's account is incremented by the withdrawal amount there is no evm execution so differences like EOA or a contract are not relevant thank you!
